summary: Omeed Malik, an investment banker and Trump donor, co-founded the venture firm 1789 Capital in 2022 with Chris Buskirk and Rebekah Mercer; Donald Trump Jr. joined as a partner in late 2024. Malik co-owns the Washington club Executive Branch and helped negotiate Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s 2024 endorsement of Trump.
